content.short: Panoptic is the perpetual, oracle-free, instant settlement options trading protocol on Ethereum.
content.description: Panoptic enables permissionless options trading on any asset pool within the Uniswap v3 ecosystem. It aims to deliver a trustless, permissionless, and fully composable options product for decentralized markets. Conceptually, Panoptic is to decentralized options markets what x·y=k automated market makers are to spot trading. Users can access the protocol through a dedicated options trading UX or by interacting directly with the underlying smart contracts.
